symptom: PC receives an IP address but cannot reach the server
topology_note: PC is located in VLAN 30 and connects through a switch to a router
show_output: Gi0/0.30 is down. switchport access vlan 30 configured on Switch port Fa0/3.
expected_fault: Missing inter-VLAN route / Subinterface administratively down

symptom: Host cannot communicate with hosts on the same switch in VLAN 10
topology_note: PC1 Fa0/1 is assigned to default VLAN 1 instead of VLAN 10
show_output: FastEthernet0/1 access vlan 1. vlan 10 name Sales exists.
expected_fault: Interface assigned to wrong VLAN

symptom: Traffic from VLAN 20 is not reaching the router across trunk link
topology_note: Switch SW1 Fa0/24 is connected to SW2 Fa0/24. Trunk allows only VLAN 10
show_output: switchport trunk allowed vlan 10 configured on Fa0/24.
expected_fault: VLAN missing from trunk allowed list

symptom: PC fails to obtain IP address via DHCP and gets APIPA address 169.254.x.x
topology_note: PC connected to SW1 Fa0/5 in VLAN 15. Router R1 acts as DHCP server
show_output: ip dhcp pool VLAN15 configured but default-router parameter missing.
expected_fault: DHCP pool missing default-router configuration

symptom: Hosts in VLAN 20 cannot obtain DHCP address across Router subinterface
topology_note: DHCP server located on remote subnet 10.0.0.100. R1 subinterface Gi0/0.20 has no ip helper-address
show_output: interface GigabitEthernet0/0.20 ip address 192.168.20.1 255.255.255.0. No helper address.
expected_fault: Missing IP helper-address on router subinterface

symptom: PC can ping IP address 8.8.8.8 but cannot browse websites using domain names
topology_note: PC configured with IP 192.168.1.50 gateway 192.168.1.1 DNS server set to 192.168.1.253 which is non-existent
show_output: ipconfig shows DNS Server: 192.168.1.253. Ping to 192.168.1.253 times out.
expected_fault: Incorrect DNS server IP configured on client

symptom: Router cannot resolve domain name for internal server web.corp.local
topology_note: Router R1 attempting to resolve DNS via ip domain-lookup without ip name-server
show_output: ip domain-lookup is enabled but show run shows no ip name-server configured.
expected_fault: Missing ip name-server configuration on router

symptom: PC in Subnet 192.168.1.0/24 cannot reach Subnet 10.1.1.0/24 across Router R1
topology_note: Router R1 has interface Gi0/0 (192.168.1.1) and Gi0/1 (10.1.1.1). Gi0/1 interface is shutdown
show_output: GigabitEthernet0/1 is administratively down line protocol is down.
expected_fault: Interface administratively shutdown

symptom: Host PC1 gateway set to 192.168.1.254 but router subinterface is 192.168.1.1
topology_note: PC1 network configuration shows Default Gateway: 192.168.1.254
show_output: ipconfig /all shows Gateway 192.168.1.254. R1 subinterface Gi0/0.10 is 192.168.1.1/24.
expected_fault: Default gateway mismatch on host

symptom: Branch office router R2 cannot reach HQ subnet 172.16.0.0/16
topology_note: R2 connected to R1 via serial link 10.0.0.0/30. R2 missing static route to HQ
show_output: show ip route on R2 shows Gateway of last resort is not set and no static route for 172.16.0.0/16.
expected_fault: Missing static route or default route

symptom: OSPF adjacency between R1 and R2 stuck in INIT state
topology_note: R1 Gi0/0 IP 10.0.0.1/30 area 0 hello-interval 10. R2 Gi0/0 IP 10.0.0.2/30 area 0 hello-interval 20
show_output: R1 show ip ospf interface Gi0/0 shows Hello 10. R2 show ip ospf interface Gi0/0 shows Hello 20.
expected_fault: OSPF Hello timer mismatch

symptom: EIGRP neighbors fail to establish relationship between R1 and R2
topology_note: R1 EIGRP AS 100 configured. R2 EIGRP AS 200 configured.
show_output: R1 router eigrp 100. R2 router eigrp 200. show ip eigrp neighbors is empty.
expected_fault: EIGRP Autonomous System (AS) mismatch

symptom: Web server 192.168.1.100 port 80 inaccessible from external network
topology_note: Router R1 ACL 101 applied inbound on Gi0/0 permits ICMP but denies TCP port 80
show_output: access-list 101 permit icmp any any. access-list 101 deny tcp any host 192.168.1.100 eq 80.
expected_fault: ACL blocking inbound HTTP traffic

symptom: Management PC 192.168.1.5 cannot SSH to Router R1 interface 10.0.0.1
topology_note: Line vty 0 4 has access-class 10 in. ACL 10 permits 192.168.1.0/28 (192.168.1.1-192.168.1.14 except .5 is denied by line 1)
show_output: access-list 10 deny host 192.168.1.5. access-list 10 permit 192.168.1.0 0.0.0.255.
expected_fault: ACL explicitly denying host access to VTY lines

symptom: Internal LAN hosts cannot access Internet through NAT Gateway R1
topology_note: R1 interface Gi0/0 (LAN) missing ip nat inside. Gi0/1 (WAN) has ip nat outside.
show_output: show ip nat statistics shows 0 inside interfaces configured.
expected_fault: Missing ip nat inside command on LAN interface

symptom: Dynamic NAT overload (PAT) fails to translate private addresses
topology_note: ip nat inside source list 1 interface Gi0/1 overload configured. ACL 1 permits 192.168.1.0 0.0.0.255. LAN IP is 172.16.1.0/24
show_output: show ip nat translations is empty. show access-lists 1 shows permit 192.168.1.0 0.0.0.255.
expected_fault: NAT ACL subnet mismatch with actual LAN IP addressing

symptom: Wireless Laptop cannot connect to WAP SSID 'Cisco_Guest'
topology_note: Wireless Access Point SSID configured as 'Cisco_Guest_Secured' with WPA2-PSK
show_output: WAP show wireless status shows SSID Cisco_Guest_Secured. Laptop attempting SSID Cisco_Guest.
expected_fault: Wireless SSID mismatch between client and WAP

symptom: Wireless Host connects to SSID but fails authentication
topology_note: WAP security set to WPA2-PSK key 'CiscoPass123!'. Client configured with key 'Ciscopass123!'
show_output: Authentication logs show PSK mismatch / radius failure on authentication handshake.
expected_fault: Wireless WPA2 Pre-Shared Key mismatch

symptom: Duplicate IP address conflict reported on Switch SW1 for 192.168.1.10
topology_note: PC1 and Printer PR1 both manually assigned IP address 192.168.1.10/24
show_output: show ip arp shows duplicate IP 192.168.1.10 mapped to two distinct MAC addresses.
expected_fault: Duplicate IP address assigned to multiple devices

symptom: PC1 and PC2 in same VLAN cannot ping due to subnet mask mismatch
expected_fault: Host subnet mask misconfiguration causing cross-subnet routing requirement

symptom: VLAN 50 created on Switch SW1 but missing on Switch SW2 across trunk
topology_note: SW1 Fa0/10 in VLAN 50. SW2 Fa0/5 in VLAN 50. SW2 has no VLAN 50 in database
show_output: show vlan brief on SW2 does not list VLAN 0050. Ports on SW2 in VLAN 50 inactive.
expected_fault: VLAN does not exist in switch VLAN database

symptom: Port Security error-disables interface Fa0/2 on Switch SW1
topology_note: Port Security max 1 MAC address violated when user plugged in secondary switch
show_output: show interface Fa0/2 shows status err-disabled. Port security violation count: 1.
expected_fault: Port security violation shutdown

symptom: DHCP pool exhausted for VLAN 10 scope 192.168.10.0/28
topology_note: Scope provides 14 usable addresses. 14 leases active. New client cannot get IP
show_output: show ip dhcp binding shows 14 active bindings. show ip dhcp pool VLAN10 shows 0 available addresses.
expected_fault: DHCP IP address pool exhaustion

symptom: DNS resolution fails because DNS server IP is not reachable from host
show_output: traceroute 10.10.10.5 fails at gateway 192.168.1.1. show ip route on router shows no route to 10.10.10.0/24.
expected_fault: Unreachable DNS server destination due to missing routing

symptom: Router R1 static route pointing to wrong next-hop IP address
topology_note: Static route configured: ip route 10.2.2.0 255.255.255.0 10.0.0.5. Next hop IP should be 10.0.0.2
show_output: show ip route shows 10.2.2.0/24 via 10.0.0.5. ARP lookup for 10.0.0.5 incomplete.
expected_fault: Incorrect static route next-hop address

symptom: OSPF Network Type mismatch on point-to-point link between R1 and R2
topology_note: R1 Gi0/0 set to ip ospf network point-to-point. R2 Gi0/0 set to broadcast default
show_output: R1 show ip ospf interface Gi0/0 shows Point-to-Point. R2 show ip ospf interface Gi0/0 shows Broadcast.
expected_fault: OSPF network type mismatch preventing full convergence

symptom: Extended ACL blocking ping ICMP traffic from Admin VLAN to Server VLAN
topology_note: ACL 105 applied inbound on subinterface Gi0/0.10 denies ICMP echoes
show_output: access-list 105 deny icmp 192.168.10.0 0.0.0.255 192.168.100.0 0.0.0.255. access-list 105 permit ip any any.
expected_fault: ACL rule blocking ICMP echo request

symptom: Static NAT translation mapping incorrect internal IP address to public IP
topology_note: ip nat inside source static 192.168.1.99 203.0.113.10 configured. Real server IP is 192.168.1.100
show_output: show ip nat translations shows 203.0.113.10 mapped to 192.168.1.99 instead of .100.
expected_fault: Static NAT internal IP address mismatch

symptom: Wireless Clients on 5GHz band unable to see SSID broadcast
topology_note: WAP 5GHz radio disabled in configuration. Only 2.4GHz radio enabled
show_output: WAP configuration shows radio 5GHz state disabled. SSID broadcast 5GHz off.
expected_fault: WAP 5GHz radio interface disabled

symptom: Wireless AP DHCP IP allocation failing due to untagged VLAN management mismatch
topology_note: WAP connected to switch port Fa0/12 set to access vlan 1. WAP expects untagged management on VLAN 100
show_output: Switch Fa0/12 configuration shows switchport access vlan 1. WAP management interface set to VLAN 100.
expected_fault: Switchport VLAN mismatch for WAP management interface

symptom: Switch STP Blocking port causing asymmetry on primary VLAN link
topology_note: Spanning Tree Protocol elected SW2 as Root Bridge for VLAN 20 instead of SW1
show_output: show spanning-tree vlan 20 shows SW2 is root. Port Fa0/1 on SW1 is in ALT/BLK state.
expected_fault: STP root bridge misconfiguration causing blocked link path

symptom: Router HSRP Active/Standby state flapping due to priority mismatch
topology_note: R1 priority 100 default, R2 priority 100 default. Preempt enabled on both
show_output: show standby brief shows both routers transitioning between Active and Speak/Standby state.
expected_fault: HSRP priority conflict and timer mismatch causing gateway flapping
